title: Circulation Around a Square via Green's Theorem
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate oint_C (y^2 dx + 3xy dy) where C is the boundary of the unit square [0, 1] x [0, 1] traversed counterclockwise.

steps.title: Compute 2D Curl Integrand
steps.mathExpression: M = y^2, \; N = 3xy \implies \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = 3y - 2y = y
steps.explanation: Differentiate N with respect to x and M with respect to y.

steps.title: Evaluate Double Integral over Unit Square
steps.explanation: Apply Green's Theorem to convert line integral to double integral.
